finding: Web classifies a receiver as stalled only when presented_fps is zero. Flutter also treated the native RTC framesPerSecond field as a stall signal, so a report could say stalled while framesRendered showed ongoing playback.

change.detail: Receiver state now uses the measured presented FPS for stall detection, matching the web reporter; the independent RTC source FPS no longer overrides evidence of rendered frames.

test_first.observation: The new regression failed before the change with state=stalled for presented_fps=20 and RTC framesPerSecond=0, then passed after the change.

receiver_report_api_flutter_test.detail: Builds a receiver report from normalized measurements and asserts the authenticated POST path, Origin, session cookie, JSON body, and omission of account/channel/track identifiers.

backend_screen_metrics_tests.detail: Backend receiver report validation and in-memory recording tests pass.

release_build.detail: Built using a temporary GRADLE_USER_HOME to avoid the existing daemon-address registry lock. The old daemon was not stopped. The first default-version install was rejected as a downgrade (35 < 2036); no app data changed.

android_runtime_smoke.detail: Cold launch restored the authenticated guild UI and SHARE_TEST opened without a fatal Android exception. The room roster rendered. Selecting the voice channel followed the normal auto-join path (listenerOnly=false); it briefly displayed 8 ms voice RTT in the channel header and call tray, then was disconnected immediately after noticing. Mic publication during that brief connection was not verified. This is voice RTT, not receiver RTT.

receiver_metrics_runtime.detail: SHARE_TEST had no remote screen publisher during the emulator check. No receiver FPS/bitrate/stalled state or ten-second packet-loss window could be compared with a live source.

web_contract_test.reason: The web package dependencies were not installed; pnpm could not reach registry.npmjs.org (ENOTFOUND). The existing test already asserts web state is stalled at presented_fps=0 and playing at a positive presented FPS.

spec_traceability.reason: pwsh and powershell are not installed on this host.

runtime_limits: The installed Android release APK is non-debuggable; Flutter attach/hot reload is unavailable. Signed in-place APK update was verified instead.
The running macOS app does not advertise a discoverable Dart VM Service; flutter attach waited without connecting. The app was not restarted.
remaining: With a live remote screen publisher, confirm the Android receiver report follows rendered FPS, bitrate and playing/stalled state, and that the ten-second packet-loss window appears only after it is complete. Repeat against the macOS receiver through a session-preserving update path; do not treat voice RTT as receiver RTT.
